messages.author: 183dd38d23595a0c
messages.subject: Controling axises in facet_gird
parts:
Is there a way to manually control the limits of an axis when using
facet_grid ? Say, have one go from -100 to 100 and another -200 to
200, which may be larger than the range of the data. The scale
argument does not give this control in this case. . . .

Thanks.

- Tommy

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Controling axises in facet_gird
parts:
Hi Tommy,

If you want to expand the limits (not contract them), you can use
geom_blank or the expand_limits function.

Hadley
